newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Abra Mining to modernise gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Abra Mining to modernise gold mine.

text.p: Abra Mining and Industrial Corp said on Wednesday it would launch a five-year programme to modernise its Patok gold mine in northern Philippines.
The company had earmarked 397 million pesos to partly finance the modernisation plan, the company told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
It did not say how much production would be generated from the programme.
Abra also said it had alloted 430 million pesos to operate its Abra River Gold Placer Mine.
The company plans to raise the money through a two-for-one rights offering to stockholders as of October 8. The new stocks would be offered at one centavo per share.
The offering period will run from October 14 to November 4.
